proposal.rationale: Asset has liboqs-0.16.0, enabling both PQC-capable profiles. Peer readiness is confirmed ('known') for all three peers, but only peer-02 and peer-03 advertise kem:x25519mlkem768, making them ready for tls13-hybrid-x25519-mlkem768 (2 endpoints). No peer advertises kem:mlkem768, so tls13-mlkem768 (pqc class) yields zero ready endpoints despite its higher security class.
